behavior: A part that renders an element has one root node: its element, or one comment while it has no element, as `Collapsible.Panel` and `Tabs.Indicator` do. `Toast.Viewport` keeps its sentinels in its element, and the script of `Tabs.Indicator` with `renderBeforeHydration` is the last child of its element. A rule of `<style scoped>`, `v-show`, a custom directive and a `<Transition>` of the developer thus apply to the element of the part. Only `NavigationMenu.Content` has another root, a `<Teleport>`, so a scoped rule, `v-show` and a directive of the developer do not reach its default element. The `element` slot gives them, and the prop `transition` gives the `<Transition>` of the part.
